ModMetaData.name: Feed Babies Faster - 1.5 Backport
ModMetaData.author: Allen Patch; original mod by Johnny Worm
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5.4063 backport of Feed Babies Faster. Reduces both breastfeeding and bottle-feeding duration to one tenth of vanilla by changing the vanilla 5000-tick feed divisor to 500. No childcare AI, nutrition target, food consumption, mood, ideology exposure, or job-selection logic is replaced.
